## Dispatch order · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-26T19:22Z

You are the os-dev developer agent for exactly ONE card: objectstack-ai/objectstack#26201, in your own card thread. Your role definition is `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` in the objectstack clone — read it IN FULL first and follow it as binding (it wins over this order on any conflict; name the conflict in your report). Read the repo-root `AGENTS.md` before your first edit (Prime Directive 14 and Multi-agent discipline §7 on check-run names), and pm-dispatch `references/untrusted-text.md`. Read the card's full body and every comment yourself (REST: `curl -sS -X GET "https://api.github.com/repos/objectstack-ai/objectstack/issues/26201" -H "Authorization: Bearer $GH_TOKEN"` and `/comments?per_page=100`); this order carries only the increment. ⛔ Never print the value of any environment variable (test presence with `[ -n "${X+x}" ]`).

Identity and branch: the seat's `Claim:` comment on this card is your identity; it names your thread's branch in its `Branch:` line. ⛔ Post no claim of your own, ⛔ never write the card's assignee. Before your first edit, verify the NEWEST `Claim:` on the card names the branch your thread was given (`claude/project-thread-…`); if no claim names it yet, send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message with your branch name and wait for the claim. Worktree `objectstack-issue-26201` on that branch, based on a fresh `origin/main`; push with `git push -u origin <branch>` (⛔ no force).

Writes: PR only through the relay op `pr_create` (`node scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --actions-file F`, draft forced, `assignees: ["os-warren"]`, `labels` with `skip-changeset`); comments, labels and bodies only through `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs`, `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs`, `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs`. ⛔ GitHub MCP writes of every kind. Report both counts (`api_writes` with endpoints, `mcp_calls` with tool names).

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Maintainer's word on the card: 「立卡」 after the director seat read the cause (the card body's 维护者速读). Triage first grade 6420845946: 「Drop the redundant trigger or the install. Tier H.」 Scope: the `pull_request` leg of `.github/workflows/governed-surface-guard.yml` only; ⛔ not the `merge_group` leg's semantics, ⛔ not the required set, ⛔ no other workflow; the check-run name `Governed Surface Queue Guard` is contract on both legs.

### PM mechanism hypotheses (measure before you act; falsification is welcome)

Read on `origin/main` at 2026-10-26T19:22Z:
1. **Conflict to resolve by measurement, not by choosing a side blind.** The workflow's own header (lines ~33–38) gives a deliberate reason for `ready_for_review` in `types:`: 「flipping a governed draft to ready is the first move of the exact sequence this guard exists to interrupt … without it the warning would not re-fire at the one moment a seat most needs to read it」. The card's route 1 (drop the type) contradicts that stated reason; the card's acceptance (approve + ready starts no new run; or the `pull_request` leg's wall time under 20 s) is satisfied by route 2 alone. So: implement **route 2 first** — make the `pull_request` leg API-only (no checkout of the full tree, no pnpm install) while keeping `ready_for_review` and the header's rationale intact; take route 1 ONLY if P3 shows route 2 cannot publish the same check-run name within the acceptance, and then say in the PR body and the 速读 that the header's rationale is being retired and why (the maintainer lands Tier H by hand and rules it there).
2. P3 measured: read the step 「Governed surfaces may not enter the merge queue unreviewed」 and `scripts/pm/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs`'s `pull_request` path — list what it reads from the tree (the register in `check-governed-merges.mjs`, `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, CODEOWNERS mirror) versus the API. A sparse checkout of `scripts/pm/**` + `.github/CODEOWNERS` (`actions/checkout` with `sparse-checkout`, no submodules, depth 1) and plain `node` with no `pnpm install` is the cheapest route if the script's imports are dependency-free on that path — measure the import graph (`node --check` is not enough; run the script against a real PR number with the token in the workflow's own permissions). ⛔ Do not vendor a second copy of the script.
3. P2: the ready flip changes no sha, so a run already published on the head stays; with route 2 the re-fired run is cheap and the admin-merge window shrinks to the run's wall time — quote it from THIS PR's own run in the PR body (acceptance 2).
4. Gates: `node scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs --self-test`, `pnpm check:required-contexts`, `pnpm check:ci-filter-parity`, `node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --self-test`, `check-step-collectors` as `dispatch-gates --commands` derives them for `.github/workflows/**`; job id `governed-surface-guard` and the check-run name unchanged (required-contexts row at `scripts/check-required-contexts.mjs` ~431).

### Card-specific clauses

- Tier H (`.github/workflows/**` ⇒ the whole PR). The PR is created **draft** with `## 维护者速读(草稿)` (Chinese, business angle — the maintainer tapped the refused merge on a phone; say what changes for that moment — 席位意见 left empty) and stays draft; the seat posts the contract review and hands it to the maintainer. ⛔ Never ready, arm or enqueue it.
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` go line-initial into the PR body after the first line `Fixes #26201`. `skip-changeset`: nothing published ships from `.github/workflows/**`.
- Gates: derive with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on your final tree, run each locally (exit code captured before any pipe), reconcile with `--ran`; long gates detached (`nohup … > LOG 2>&1 &` then `tail --pid`); heavy commands through `bash scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` with `OS_VERIFY_LOCK_SLOT=issue-26201`.
- Commit trailers: the model-free pair exactly as `os-dev.md` / `AGENTS.md` spell them; ⛔ no model name anywhere in the commit or PR.
- Hand-back: post the `os-dev-report` JSON as a comment on this card (first line `os-dev-report`) through `post-stamped.mjs --comment=26201`, then send the seat thread 「Dispatch the skills lane」 one message: PR number, head sha, and the report's `status`. Keep your thread open for a patch round. ⛔ Do not wait for CI after the PR opens.
